newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Ansett says has no plans for Macau flights.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Ansett says has no plans for Macau flights.

text.p: Ansett Airlines Ltd said on Tuesday it would not to apply for permission to fly to the Portuguese enclave of Macau in favour of boosting its flights to neighbouring Hong Kong from five to seven times a week.
Ansett had examined the possibility of flying to Macau but had decided against the move, spokesman Peter Young said.
Hong Kong's South China Morning Post newspaper reported on Tuesday that Ansett was considering flights to Macau.
"We don't have any immediate ambitions to start services there," Young said.
"We currently fly to Hong Kong five days a week and our immediate priority is to build that up to a daily service."
Ansett last week said it had won permission from Australia's International Air Services Commission to begin daily flights between Osaka in Japan and Australia from mid-year.
Young said Ansett last month withdrew an application to fly to Bangkok. "When we made that decision our objective was to concentrate on our existing core business," Young said.
Ansett is equally owned by News Corp Ltd and Air New Zealand Ltd.
